agents.name: truevision_worker_receipt_router.py
agents.definition: [agent] route one TrueVision worker receipt into a SecureCore decision packet

risk.reason: reads worker receipt and writes separate decision packet

contract.assumptions_in: Worker receipt exists and is JSON object
contract.assumptions_out: Decision packet records routing only and does not promote truth

agents.name: truevision_consensus_reasoning_agent.py
agents.definition: [agent] candidate-only consensus over worker evidence packets

risk.reason: reads candidate packets and writes separate consensus decision

contract.assumptions_in: Input packets are JSON or JSONL candidate evidence packets
contract.assumptions_out: Consensus remains candidate-only and requires operator review

agents.name: truevision_zero_tolerance_gate_agent.py
agents.definition: [agent] validate TrueVision handoff package against SecureCore live-agent manifest and catalog shape

risk.reason: reads handoff package and writes separate gate report

contract.assumptions_in: Handoff root mirrors SecureCore live_agents AGENTS structure
contract.assumptions_out: Reports pass or reject without activating agents
